scope: Native Deep Capture product paths shipped through S124

boundaries.description: Operator selection becomes an immutable target-scoped authorized plan.
An owned target process receives only its session-scoped route and capability.
A loopback client proves the exact session capability before forwarding.
The proxy resolves names and applies policy to canonical resulting addresses.
Each upstream TCP, UDP, TLS, QUIC, or HTTP connection is separately policy checked.
Untrusted bytes enter bounded protocol parsers without semantic normalization.
Client-facing TLS uses the session authority while upstream TLS verifies independently.
Bounded observations become sensitive evidence under explicit artifact authority.
boundaries.owner: fragcap facade and CLI artifact writers

boundaries.description: Synchronized resource obligations become exact cleanup and Doctor recovery decisions.

assets.description: Random secret admitting only the selected routed client.
Permission to route the selected target through the loopback proxy.
Proxy-owned ability to resolve and connect to destinations.
Per-session authority and leaf private material.
Application plaintext, metadata, bodies, messages, and datagrams.
Key log, certificates, application evidence, journals, and exported bundle copies.
Exact live listener, trust, route, process, and artifact cleanup obligations.
Proof that the routed process and descendants belong to the authorized launch.

threats.title: Unrelated local client uses the proxy
prevention: Exact random per-session Basic or RFC 1929 proof precedes payload forwarding.
Routing is injected only into the owned child environment.
detection: Authentication refusal and route-ownership outcomes are counted.
containment: The exact loopback listener and capability die with the finite session lease.

tests.proves: Wrong HTTP proxy proof cannot forward payload.
Wrong SOCKS5 proof cannot reach the origin.
A second local UDP client cannot seize an association.

threats.title: Malicious destination obtains prohibited upstream access
prevention: Every canonical destination is denied unless public or exactly granted.
Listener and private addresses are checked after mapped-address normalization.
detection: Policy refusals retain destination class and terminal stage.
containment: Refusal occurs before upstream connect or datagram transmission.

tests.proves: Private and listener-local destinations require exact grants.
A refused private destination creates no upstream connection.
UDP policy refusals and malformed requests remain finite and counted.

threats.title: A name changes to a prohibited or different peer
prevention: The proxy owns resolution, policy checks each resolved address, and connects only the selected peer.
UDP replies require an exact contacted-peer entry.
detection: Resolved address, selected peer, and refused or unsolicited outcomes are retained.
containment: Peer maps are finite and never silently replace an authorized peer.

tests.proves: Authority parsing cannot collapse ambiguous names or literals.
An origin not contacted by the association cannot inject a reply.
Peer saturation cannot replace established ownership.

threats.title: Conflicting framing changes request meaning
prevention: Conflicting content lengths and transfer encodings are refused before connect.
Unknown protocol semantics never inherit HTTP eligibility.
detection: Parser failure and classification reason remain distinct terminal facts.
containment: The client connection is retired without forwarding ambiguous bytes.

tests.proves: Ambiguous HTTP framing never reaches an origin.
Invalid classification combinations do not normalize to support.

threats.title: A peer exhausts finite proxy resources
prevention: Connections, streams, buffers, bodies, observations, peers, and identities have explicit bounds.
detection: Every saturation and omitted byte has a named counter or terminal outcome.
containment: New work is refused or observation is dropped independently from forwarding; existing ownership is not evicted.

tests.proves: Connection budget exhaustion and occupied endpoints refuse startup work.
UDP retention bounds do not corrupt forwarding or hide loss.
QUIC limits are finite and replayable early data is disabled.

threats.title: Session certificate authority escapes its scope
prevention: Authorities are per-session, leaves use exact validated identities, private storage is protected, and upstream trust is independent.
detection: Trust identity, leaf issuance, store mismatch, and cleanup states are journaled.
containment: Trust and private material are exact resource obligations removed without touching unrelated authorities.

tests.proves: Malformed leaf identities cannot obtain certificates.
Private material is protected in owned storage.
Upstream name and trust failures cannot downgrade.

threats.title: Artifact paths or exports expose unintended data
prevention: Sensitive storage is protected before capture, paths are canonical and confined, and export is a separate explicit copy with a transformation manifest.
detection: Manifest sensitivity, omission, transformation, and finalization fields are exhaustive.
containment: Cleanup targets only the exact owned bundle; export never mutates the source.

tests.proves: Cleanup requires confirmation and preserves non-sensitive evidence.
Export is isolated and declares every transformation.
Existing bundle content cannot be overwritten by session startup.

threats.title: Interrupted cleanup mutates unrelated or unowned resources
prevention: Every effect is preceded by a synchronized exact obligation; Doctor reuses the same recovery decision and requires confirmation.
detection: Crash-readable journal prefixes and terminal trailers preserve partial state.
containment: Recovery refuses active, ambiguous, unknown-versioned, and unrelated resources while continuing independent cleanup.

tests.proves: One cleanup failure cannot suppress remaining cleanup or evidence.
Unexpected session drop cleans exact acquired resources once.
Doctor exposes exact residue and recovery action.

threats.title: A different process inherits target authority
prevention: Authorization binds an immutable plan, launch root, ancestry, process generation, route, and capability.
detection: Warm, escaped, ambiguous, stale, and mismatched identities retain distinct refusals.
containment: No session effect begins after failed preflight and no authority transfers on PID or endpoint reuse.

tests.proves: An escaped client cannot inherit platform ownership.
A stale authorization cannot create effects.
Listener endpoint reuse cannot transfer capability.

threats.title: Ambiguous traffic downgrades into transparent forwarding
prevention: Each routed family has an explicit classification and unknown ALPN, migration, changed endpoints, invalid framing, and unsupported semantics refuse without transparent fallback.
detection: Classification, inspectability, refusal reason, and loss remain separate facts.
containment: Failure retires only the affected connection or association under finite cleanup.

tests.proves: QUIC migration and route changes are refused.
SOCKS TCP malformed and policy outcomes remain distinct.
Malformed bypass policy cannot reach listener selection.
